digo_source: Pakia 2005 Appendix III ('Mkadi'); ICRAF Useful Trees gives 'Digo: Mkapu'

teaser.en: Its flowers are so fragrant that cooks steep them in coconut milk, and its spiny leaves are woven into mats and baskets.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yana harufu nzuri kiasi kwamba wapishi huyaloweka katika tui la nazi, na majani yake yenye miiba husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu.
teaser.dg: Maruwage gana arufu nono sana hata ajiti nkugatiya kpwenye huwi, na makodzage genye miya nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango.

summary.en: *Mkadi*, the screw pine, is a coastal tree on stilt roots with long, spiny strap-shaped leaves and fragrant flowers. It is grown near homes for its weaving leaves, its scented flowers and its shelter from the wind.
summary.sw: *Mkadi* ni mti wa pwani unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili, wenye majani marefu kama utepe yenye miiba, na maua yenye harufu nzuri. Hupandwa karibu na nyumba kwa ajili ya majani yake ya kusuka, maua yake yenye harufu nzuri na kuzuia upepo.
summary.dg: *Mkadi* ni muhi wa pwani unaoima dzulu ya mizi ya kuimirira, wenye makodza mare genye miya, mabapa dza mkanda, na maruwa genye arufu nono. Nkuphandwa phephi na nyumba kpwa sababu ya makodzage ga kusuka, maruwage genye arufu nono na kuzuwiya phepho.

about.en:
*Mkadi* is a tree of 4 to 8 metres that stands on stilt roots, much like a mangrove, propping it up in loose sand and wet ground. The leaves are long, stiff and strap-shaped, edged with small sharp spines, and they spiral around the branch tips in tufts. That spiral arrangement, like the thread of a screw, gives the English name.

The flowers are what people notice first: they are strongly fragrant. Pakia notes that the Digo recognise the plant by its leaves and its aromatic flowers. The fruit is a large, knobbly head made of many woody segments.
about.sw:
*Mkadi* ni mti wa mita 4 hadi 8 unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili, kama mkoko, inayoushikilia katika mchanga laini na ardhi yenye majimaji. Majani yake ni marefu, magumu na yenye umbo la utepe, yenye miiba midogo mikali kwenye kingo, na yanazunguka ncha za matawi kwa mzunguko kama vishungi. Mpangilio huo wa mzunguko, kama mzunguko wa skrubu, ndio uliompa jina lake la Kiingereza.

Maua ndiyo kitu ambacho watu hukiona kwanza: yana harufu kali nzuri. Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa majani yake na maua yake yenye harufu nzuri. Tunda lake ni kichwa kikubwa chenye vinundu, kilichoundwa na vipande vingi vigumu kama mbao.
about.dg:
*Mkadi* ni muhi wa mita 4 hadi 8 unaoima dzulu ya mizi ya kuimirira, dza mkoko, inayougbwira kpwenye mtsanga usiokala mgumu na tsi ya mtope. Makodzage ni mare, magumu na mabapa dza mkanda, na kanda-kanda gana miya midide ya ntsa; ganazunguluka ntsa za panda kpwa mafungu. Mpangilio hinyu wa kuzunguluka, dza wa skrubu, ndio unaolavya dzina ra Chingereza.

Atu nkuona maruwa kpwandza: gana arufu nono sana. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya mmea hinyu kpwa makodzage na maruwage genye arufu nono. Tundare ni kulu, ra mafundo-mafundo, rinarohendwa ni vipande vinji vigumu.

where.en: It grows on coastal sands, along creeks and in swampy places, and it is often planted near homes. On the south coast, look for its stilt roots and spiralling crowns of spiky leaves near villages behind the beach and along the edges of creeks.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye mchanga wa pwani, kando ya hori na mahali penye majimaji, na mara nyingi hupandwa karibu na nyumba. Pwani ya kusini, tafuta mizizi-mihimili yake na mataji yake ya majani yenye miiba yanayozunguka karibu na vijiji vilivyo nyuma ya ufuo na kando ya kingo za hori.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye mtsanga wa pwani, kanda-kanda ya mikono ya bahari na phatu pha madzi-madzi, na mara nyinji nkuphandwa phephi na nyumba. Pwani ya kusini, endza miziye ya kuimirira na vitswavye vya makodza genye miya ganagozunguluka, phephi na vidzidzi virivyo nyuma ya ufuwo na kanda-kanda ya mikono ya bahari.

uses.en:
The leaves are stripped of their spines, split and woven into mats and baskets.

The fragrant flowers are steeped in coconut milk to scent it. The flowers and roots are used in medicine, and the trees are planted as windbreaks.
uses.sw:
Majani huondolewa miiba, hupasuliwa na kusukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu.

Maua yenye harufu nzuri huloweshwa katika tui la nazi ili kulitia harufu. Maua na mizizi hutumika katika dawa, na miti hupandwa kuzuia upepo.
uses.dg:
Makodza nkuuswa miya, nkuahulwa na nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango.

Maruwa genye arufu nono nkutiywa kpwenye huwi ili rikale na arufu nono. Maruwa na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa, na mihi nkuphandwa kuzuwiya phepho.

culture.en: Pakia notes that the Digo identify *mkadi* by its leaves and its aromatic flowers, the two things that make it useful.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua *mkadi* kwa majani yake na maua yake yenye harufu nzuri, vitu viwili vinavyoufanya kuwa na manufaa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya *mkadi* kpwa makodzage na maruwage genye arufu nono, vitu viiri vinavyoufwahisa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkadi*, which is also the Swahili and Giriama name. The ICRAF tree handbook gives *mkapu* instead. Since the Mgombato dictionary and Pakia both use *mkapu* (or *kapu*) for the lemon, the ICRAF name needs checking with speakers. In English it is the screw pine, and its scientific name is *Pandanus kirkii*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkadi*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili na la Kigiriama. Kitabu cha miti cha ICRAF badala yake kinatoa *mkapu*. Kwa kuwa kamusi ya Mgombato na Pakia wote hutumia *mkapu* (au *kapu*) kwa mlimau, jina la ICRAF linahitaji kuthibitishwa na wazungumzaji. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *screw pine*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Pandanus kirkii*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkadi*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiriama. Chitabu cha mihi cha ICRAF chinalavya *mkapu* badalaye. Kpwa vira kamusi ya Mgombato na Pakia vyosi viiri vinahumira *mkapu* (au *kapu*) kpwa limau, dzina ra ICRAF rinahitaji kulolwa na atu anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *screw pine*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pandanus kirkii*.

reason.en: Same genus: the Rabai screw pine
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga: *screw pine* ya Rabai

reason.en: Its coconut milk is scented with mkadi flowers
reason.sw: Tui lake la nazi hutiwa harufu kwa maua ya mkadi
reason.dg: Huwire nkutiywa arufu nono kpwa maruwa ga *mkadi*

reason.en: Another plant whose leaves are woven into mats and baskets
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ambao majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina ambao makodzage nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango

reason.en: The lemon, which shares the name mkapu in some sources
reason.sw: Mlimau, ambao katika baadhi ya vyanzo una jina hilo hilo, mkapu
reason.dg: Limau, ambaro vitabu vyanjina vinariiha piya *mkapu*
